scope: Official URDF appearance and educational research roadmap; replay of the existing frozen simulation, not a new control experiment.

python_tests.evidence: Parent agent full pytest tool result; no persisted test log was supplied.

official_visual_model.simplification: Deterministic vertex clustering; all material parts retained. This is a display mesh, not a conservative collision mesh or a surface Hausdorff bound.

reference_review.scope: Targeted primary-source educational reading list; no claim of a complete systematic review.

portable_rebuild.evidence: Parent agent successful exit-0 tool result: Wrote build/index.html and SciencePlots PNG/PDF figures. No physics advanced.

frozen_data_provenance.pose_source: Existing 41 recorded fixed-base hierarchy states; no physical telemetry.
frozen_data_provenance.regenerated_command_queries: Frozen-state query regeneration agreed on solutions; only solve_ms timings differed. The original command JSON and corresponding HTML payload were reused, preserving every prior command and timing.

licensing.source_mesh_derivation: Rendered meshes are derived from the existing Yang-Ci CERN-OHL-W-2.0 copy after verifying identical SHA-256 hashes against the official Seeed-hosted files.
licensing.official_package_declaration: Apache-2.0 is declared by the ROS package; no root repository license was found and no blanket relicensing of inherited assets is inferred.

limitations: Appearance, FK and browser-runtime tests do not establish hardware or continuous-time safety.
The existing velocity-filter comparison uses frozen-state projections; no new mobile-manipulator, perception, or hardware experiment was run.
The research page is an educational implementation plan; the cited external methods were neither installed nor reproduced.
